department.en: Social Welfare Department, Govt of NCT of Delhi

summary.en: A one-time ₹20,000 for the family of a breadwinner who died aged 18 to 60, if family income is low.
summary.hi: 18 से 60 वर्ष की उम्र में कमाने वाले की मृत्यु पर, कम आय वाले परिवार को एक बार ₹20,000।
summary.hn: 18 se 60 saal ki umar mein kamane wale ki maut par, kam income wale parivaar ko ek baar ₹20,000.

text.en: One-time assistance of ₹20,000, paid to the applicant's Aadhaar-linked bank account through PFMS.
The scheme is for family members of a household's main earner (the member whose earnings were the largest part of household income) who died while aged 18 to 60.
The applicant has lived in Delhi for more than 5 years before applying.
Family income of the applicant is not more than ₹1,00,000 a year.
The applicant has an Aadhaar number and a singly-operated bank account in the National Capital Territory of Delhi linked to Aadhaar.
Age proof and residence proof (the same lists as for the old-age pension: for example a birth certificate, ration card, voter card, Aadhaar, passport or utility bill).

Proof of the earner's death: a death certificate from the Registrar of Births and Deaths, a cremation ground or graveyard receipt, a hospital certificate, a certificate of the Block Development Officer if the death was outside Delhi or in a village, or a post mortem report.
One passport size photo, and an income self-declaration in the format on the portal.
Not stated on the official page: verify locally.
Normally within 45 days of receiving the application, unless circumstances dictate otherwise.

Apply online on the e-District portal after registering through citizen login, or at your District Social Welfare Office. Aadhaar is mandatory: the portal does not work without it. Scan and upload the documents.
The District Social Welfare Office scrutinises the application and may call you with documents for verification.
If sanctioned, the one-time amount is sent to your bank account.
